title: Maximum Subarray
summary: Find the largest sum of a non-empty run of consecutive numbers (Kadane's algorithm).

tests.explain: [5, -1, 2] sums to 6. Adding the 3 and -4 in front would contribute -1, which only lowers it.
Every number is negative and the subarray can't be empty, so the best is the single largest number.
A single element is its own only subarray.

hints: Ask a narrower question for every index i: what is the best sum of a subarray that ends exactly at i?
A subarray ending at i either is just [nums[i]], or extends the best subarray ending at i - 1. Take whichever is larger.
Keep that 'best ending here' value and the overall best in two variables. Start both at nums[0], not 0, or all-negative inputs break.
